pages.title: National Bank of Egypt - Branch Appointment Booking
pages.text:
Appointment booking service
Service
The service enables all NBE or non-NBE customers to book an appointment through NBE's website.
The branches at which the booking service is available will appear to the customers when they attempt to book an appointment. The service is free of charge and available 24/7.
Customers are allowed to book only one appointment across all NBE branches where this service is available, within official working hours.
Customers can amend the scheduled appointment date and/or time as well as cancel it if no longer needed.
The customer can amend the date of their scheduled appointment at any time before the actual timing of the appointment specified by them.
The timing of the appointment cannot be changed to another time on the same appointment day.
To check in, please show up at the branch at least one minute before the scheduled appointment and no later than 15 minutes.
The customer cannot book an appointment for the same day.
Steps for appointment booking through NBE's website:
Enter your national ID number and mobile phone number.
If you are an NBE customer: enter your national ID number and mobile phone number registered with NBE. If you enter a national ID or mobile phone number that is not registered with NBE, you will not be able to proceed with appointment booking, and you will be directed to visit the branch to update your information.
Enter your e-mail address (optional), then click “Submit”.
Choose the department (Customer Service, Teller or Reception), or IBAG (only branches where the service is available will be shown), select the required service, then click “Submit”.
If your information must be updated, you will be directed to Information Update service only. Once you show up at the branch at the scheduled appointment, you will be transferred to any other department/service at the branch after you complete the procedures required for information update.
Choose the required NBE branch through one of the following methods
If you have agreed to sharing your location with NBE, you can select from the nearest 10 branches that will appear to you.
If you want to choose a specific branch or you do not want to share your location through NBE's website, you can choose the region, the area then the branch which you want to visit from the available branches in the region and area. (Note: You can type the branch name directly after selecting the region and area), then click “Submit”.
Choose the preferred day and time for your appointment, then click “Submit”.
Your scheduled appointment details will be displayed, including all the information entered in the previous steps (department, service, branch name, appointment number, date, and time). You can download the appointment details or amend/cancel the appointment.
When you arrive at the branch at your scheduled appointment time, you can check in using one of the following methods:
Scan the QR Code given with the booked appointment details to check-in and print your appointment details (only available at branches which have QR code readers).
Select the “Check-In” option on the kiosk screen, enter the mobile number, then your appointment time and required service will be displayed. Press the “Appointment” button to receive your appointment details and complete the check-in process.
Announcement
Branches located in clubs and sovereign entities are accessible to authorized persons only.
Please note that if your appointment falls on an official public holiday announced by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), it will be automatically canceled. Therefore, kindly schedule a new appointment on an official working day.
Islamic branches (Al-Azhar and Tahrir Islamic Branches) offer products of a special nature.

pages.title: National Bank of Egypt - Become An NBE Customer
pages.text:
Dear Valued Customer,
Kindly be informed with the following:
This service is provided only to new retail customers to the bank who are residents in Egypt, over 21 years old, and have a valid National Identification Number (National Identification Number written in a valid passport is accepted “but the passport number is not accepted”).
This service isn't available with power of attorney, for minors, as a gift account, and for people who can’t read or write.
To secure the original requested documents and obtain the physical signature in order to complete your request, the National Bank of Egypt offers two options:
Visit one of the NBE branches:
Visit one of the NBE's e-branches: Choose the time and date to visit that branch. If, for whatever reason, you miss your appointment, or you did not pay the branch a visit within 10 working days from the day of your appointment, your request will be automatically canceled and you will have to apply again. Kindly note that instant debit card issuance, is available only in select branches (specified when selecting the e-branch you will be visiting)
Visit one of NBE's traditional branches:
request to meet the Retail Banking Manager in person or whoever is on his behalf in the branch to direct you to the relevant colleague to speed up your application. If, for whatever reason, you did not pay the branch a visit within 10 working days from the day of submitting the request, your request will be automatically canceled and you will have to apply again
Request a personal visit from a bank employee (available only in select governorates). This service is only available to senior citizens (60 years old and older), women, and individual with special needs (provided that they can see, hear, read and write). An employee will contact you on the mobile number you entered in the application request (within two working days) to arrange with you the date and time of the visit and inform you of the requested documents so you can prepare them with copies to proceed with the application. If the employee couldn't reach you or couldn't arrange your appointment with you or you didn't prepare the requested documents, your request will be automatically canceled and you will have to apply again.
Account Opening Steps:
Enter your NID and mobile number.
Enter the OTP sent to the mobile number.(taking into consideration not to disclose it to anyone)
Enter your email twice.
Enter OTP sent to that email (please check the Junk Folder) taking into consideration not to disclose it to anyone.
Enter the required Information for account opening request.
For signature submission and required document completion, please choose one of these options:
Visit nearest branches.
Request a personal visit from a bank employee. (T&C applied)
Mark "Check" on Terms and Condition (Reading and Confirmation).
You will receive an email on the entered email address to confirm your request. (Please check the Junk Folder in case you don’t find it in the inbox.)
